long_biography.plain_text:
Munro studied economics at the University of Glasgow and later completed an executive MBA at London Business School. His operating career included senior roles at Exel Logistics, Linfox and RoadLink, where he managed supply-chain businesses across Europe, Asia-Pacific and North America. At RoadLink, he led an intermodal trucking and logistics group backed by private equity.

Co-founding AVC Partners with Marc Kramer shifted Munro's work from chief-executive and board roles into private equity. The firm backs lower-middle-market companies in business services, transportation, logistics, distribution and light manufacturing, pairing majority investment with active operational support. Munro remains involved in strategy, performance improvement and portfolio leadership rather than acting solely as a passive capital provider.
